verdict.rationale: Fedora ships GNOME Software, explicitly advertised as enabling one-click installs from Fedora repos, Flathub, or elsewhere (fedora-docs-8), which matches the story. However, a hands-on community report describes trying to install popular apps like Discord and Spotify and instead needing a full page of terminal commands, with installed GUI apps failing to appear in the app launcher (fedora-comm-15) — a concrete contradiction of the frictionless one-click claim for popular software. missing for 10: independent corroboration that one-click install reliably works for mainstream apps, and resolution of the conflicting hands-on failure report.
